name: Tally
author: Erin Carter
description: An LED dot-matrix board running like a spectrum meter — columns of round LEDs bouncing to their own rhythm with peak-hold caps, lit dots grading cool-to-warm by height over a faint dark grid of off pixels. Crisp, rhythmic, electronic.

params.label: Columns
params.effect: Number of LED columns; low is a chunky board, high a fine matrix.

params.label: Speed
params.effect: How fast the bars bounce; 0 freezes the board.

params.label: LED size
params.effect: Size of each LED dot; low is pinpoint, high nearly fills its cell.

params.label: Off glow
params.effect: Brightness of the unlit grid dots; 0 hides them, higher shows the whole panel.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer drives its column to full height; 0 ignores the mouse.
